title: IVG Pro 12 Hub Blast Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Hub Blast delivers the timeless taste of classic confectionery in a smooth and aromatic profile. This retro-inspired flavour captures the sugary, distinctive notes of pink Bubblegum, offering a sweet and playful vape without any added fruit or ice. It provides a pure and satisfying candy experience that stays consistent from the first puff to the last. Designed exclusively for the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Kit, this pack utilises a smart refilling system to deliver extended performance. The pack includes a replaceable 2ml prefilled pod and a separate 10ml e-liquid refill container. This combination allows you to automatically refill the pod while it is attached to the device, offering up to 10,000 puffs per pack and the flexibility to swap flavours whenever you choose. When the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them with a new set to continue enjoying your IVG Pro 12 device. Try all flavours with our full IVG Pro 12 pods range . How To Setup IVG Pro 12 Pod + Refill: Step 1 Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. Step 2 Remove any safety stickers from the components. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the device. Step 4 Attach the refill container to the side of the device. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. Step 6 Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
